scientific_integrity: All claims derive from explicit branch calculations, a finite-dimensional determinant and analytic root continuation; finite tests are evidence of consistency but not of infinite-dimensional completeness or priority.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to this precise map, normalized Lebesgue invariant law, and coordinate-linear observable correlations; spectral slowdown is a lower bound on maximal eigenvalue modulus, not its exact first-order asymptotic. Historical priority remains subject to independent review.
title: Exact coordinate-correlation spectrum and dimension-delayed sign reversal for the twisted baker map
